verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents running a local instance of Airbyte Core in Docker via abctl, with setup in minutes (docs-12, docs-13, docs-52). PyAirbyte extracts data into local caches, and the docs recommend it for Jupyter or early prototyping without running a server, which covers a lightweight local target (docs-47, docs-40). Terraform config-as-code offers a plausible path to reproduce a tested setup elsewhere (docs-2), and one older hands-on report of a failed local docker-compose install lowers confidence (comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a lightweight destination type (e.g. a named local DB or file destination), a documented local-to-production promotion workflow, and recent independent corroboration that local testing works smoothly.
